)
files <- c(changed, reference)

---
name: transcriptomics
description: Domain knowledge for RNA-seq differential expression, annotation, and visualization.

# Transcriptomics

Domain knowledge for RNA-seq differential expression analysis and
visualization.

## Expected Workflow

1. Confirm the experimental design first:
   - condition labels
   - reference level
   - replicate structure
2. Run differential expression on the correct count matrix and keep the
   sign convention explicit.
3. Treat annotation as a separate step that must preserve row identity.
4. Build plots from the same DE result and normalized matrix that support
   the final interpretation.
5. Accept the output bundle only if the table, annotation, and plots all
   tell the same biological story.

from bioblend.galaxy.tools.inputs import (
    conditional,
    dataset,
    inputs,
    repeat,
)


def test_conditional():
    # Build up example inputs for random_lines1
    as_dict = (
        inputs()
        .set("num_lines", 5)
        .set("input", dataset("encoded1"))
        .set("seed_source", conditional().set("seed_source_selector", "set_seed").set("seed", "asdf"))
        .to_dict()
    )
    assert as_dict["num_lines"] == 5
    assert as_dict["input"]["src"] == "hda"
    assert as_dict["input"]["id"] == "encoded1"
    assert as_dict["seed_source|seed_source_selector"] == "set_seed"
    assert as_dict["seed_source|seed"] == "asdf"


def test_repeat():
    # Build up inputs for cat1
    as_dict = (
        inputs()
        .set("input1", dataset("encoded1"))
        .set(
            "queries",
            repeat()
            .instance(inputs().set_dataset_param("input2", "encoded2"))
            .instance(inputs().set_dataset_param("input2", "encoded3")),
        )

pressions. Optionally, you can input one or more secondary factors that might influence your experiment. But the final output will be changes in genes

# Transcriptomics

Domain knowledge for RNA-seq differential expression analysis and
visualization.

## Expected Workflow

1. Confirm the experimental design first:
   - condition labels
   - reference level
   - replicate structure
2. Run differential expression on the correct count matrix and keep the
   sign convention explicit.
3. Treat annotation as a separate step that must preserve row identity.

visualization.

1. Confirm the experimental design first:
   - condition labels

   - replicate structure

   sign convention explicit.

4. Build plots from the same DE result and normalized matrix that support
   the final interpretation.
5. Accept the output bundle only if the table, annotation, and plots all
   tell the same biological story.

/usr/bin/bash -c "python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

workspace = Path('/workspace')
out_dir = workspace / 'final_answer'
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

samples = {
    'SRR5085167': 'reference',
    'SRR5085168': 'reference',
    'SRR5085169': 'changed',
    'SRR5085170': 'changed',
}

rows = []
for sample, condition in samples.items():
    group = 'counts_from_reference_condition' if condition == 'reference' else 'counts_from_changed_condition'
    path = next((workspace / 'data' / 'inputs' / group).glob(f'{sample.lower()}_counts_table/*.dat'))
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep='\\t')
    df.columns = ['Geneid', sample]
    rows.append(df)

counts = rows[0]
for df in rows[1:]:
    counts = counts.merge(df, on='Geneid', how='outer')
counts = counts.set_index('Geneid')

# Required prefilter: >= 10 raw counts in at least two of the four samples.
keep = (counts >= 10).sum(axis=1) >= 2
counts_filtered = counts.loc[keep].astype(int).T  # PyDESeq2 expects samples x genes

metadata = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        'condition': pd.Categorical(
            [samples[s] for s in counts_filtered.index],
            categories=['reference', 'changed'],
            ordered=True,
        )
    },
    index=counts_filtered.index,
)

dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_filtered,
    metadata=metadata,
    design='~condition',
    quiet=True,
)
dds.deseq2()

# Unshrunken LFCs; BH adjustment across every retained gene.
stats = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=['condition', 'changed', 'reference'],
    independent_filter=False,
    cooks_filter=False,
    quiet=True,
)
stats.summary()
res = stats.results_df.copy()
res.index.name = 'gene_id'
res = res.rename(
    columns={
        'log2FoldChange': 'log2_fold_change',
        'pvalue': 'p_value',
        'padj': 'fdr',
    }
)[['log2_fold_change', 'p_value', 'fdr']]

# Guard rails required by the task.
assert len(res) == int(keep.sum())
assert res.index.is_unique
assert np.isfinite(res[['log2_fold_change', 'p_value', 'fdr']].to_numpy()).all()
assert (res[['p_value', 'fdr']].to_numpy() >= 0).all()
assert (res[['p_value', 'fdr']].to_numpy() <= 1).all()

out_tsv = out_dir / 'differential_expression.tsv'
res.to_csv(out_tsv, sep='\\t', index=True, float_format='%.17g')

method = {'method': 'DESeq2'}
(out_dir / 'method.json').write_text(json.dumps(method) + '\\n')

# Concise execution log.
trace_dir = workspace / 'run_trace'
trace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(trace_dir / 'analysis.log').write_text(
    'Read four raw count tables (reference: SRR5085167, SRR5085168; changed: SRR5085169, SRR5085170).\\n'
    f'Input genes: {counts.shape[0]}.\\n'
    'Filter: retain genes with >= 10 raw counts in at least two of four samples.\\n'
    f'Retained genes tested: {len(res)}.\\n'
    'Method: DESeq2 (PyDESeq2), design ~condition, contrast changed vs reference.\\n'
    'Results: unshrunken log2 fold change, Wald p-value, BH FDR across retained genes.\\n'
    f'Output: final_answer/differential_expression.tsv and final_answer/method.json.\\n'
)

print('wrote', out_tsv)
print('rows', len(res))
print('columns', res.columns.tolist())
print('first rows:')
print(res.head().to_string())
print('min p', res['p_value'].min(), 'max p', res['p_value'].max())
print('min fdr', res['fdr'].min(), 'max fdr', res['fdr'].max())
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

inputs = {
 'SRR5085167':'/workspace/data/inputs/counts_from_reference_condition/srr5085167_counts_table/srr5085167_counts_table.dat',
 'SRR5085168':'/workspace/data/inputs/counts_from_reference_condition/srr5085168_counts_table/srr5085168_counts_table.dat',
 'SRR5085169':'/workspace/data/inputs/counts_from_changed_condition/srr5085169_counts_table/srr5085169_counts_table.dat',
 'SRR5085170':'/workspace/data/inputs/counts_from_changed_condition/srr5085170_counts_table/srr5085170_counts_table.dat',
}

dfs=[]
for sample, path in inputs.items():
    df=pd.read_csv(path, sep='\\t')
    if list(df.columns) "'!= ['"'Geneid', sample]:
        raise ValueError(f'Unexpected columns for {sample}: {list(df.columns)}')
    dfs.append(df.set_index('Geneid').rename(columns={sample: sample}))

counts_genes = dfs[0].join(dfs[1:], how='outer')
assert not counts_genes.index.duplicated().any()
assert counts_genes.shape[0] == 7127

# Required prefilter: >=10 raw counts in at least two of the four samples.
keep = (counts_genes >= 10).sum(axis=1) >= 2
counts_filtered = counts_genes.loc[keep].T.astype(int)
metadata = pd.DataFrame({
    'condition': ['reference','reference','changed','changed']
}, index=counts_filtered.index)

    counts=counts_filtered,
    metadata=metadata,
    design='~condition',
    refit_cooks=False,

)

import collections

print('retained:', len(ret))

# Compute BH across retained genes using p-values sorted ascending.
sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k3,3g run_trace/retained_de.tsv | awk -F'\\t' 'BEGIN{m=0} {m++; gene[m]="'$1; p[m]=$3+0; raw[m]=$3; lfc[m]=$2} END{for(i=1;i<=m;i++){q[i]=p[i]*m/i; if(q[i]>1)q[i]=1} prev=1; for(i=m;i>=1;i--){if(q[i]<prev)prev=q[i]; else q[i]=prev} for(i=1;i<=m;i++) printf "%s'"\\t%s\\n\", gene[i], q[i]}' > run_trace/retained_fdr.tsv

awk -F'\\t' 'NR==FNR{fdr["'$1]=$2; next} {gid=$1; if(gid in fdr){print}}'"' run_trace/retained_fdr.tsv run_trace/retained_de.tsv > run_trace/retained_de_with_fdr_deseq_order.tsv
